name: NetBird Server
description: NetBird builds a WireGuard-based overlay network between your machines. This VM runs the self-hosted management server, signal service and relay.

notes.text: Default settings use Debian 13; Advanced settings offer other Debian/Ubuntu cloud images. Shared Cloud-Init configures credentials/networking when enabled. NetBird domain/proxy settings are required after VM settings; unattended deployment requires VM_NETBIRD_DOMAIN. Setup is staged with the netbird-setup.service first-boot unit; follow it with tail -f /var/log/netbird-setup.log. If Docker cannot be pre-installed, install-docker.service runs first and logs to /var/log/install-docker.log.
If you use Cloud-init, checkout cloud-init discussion: `https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/discussions/272`
